scope: Production build parameter and exact local URL policy only; no game metadata/assets/physics/controller protocol changes

nativeBuildFixture.firstAttempt: Tiny fixture initially duplicated shared tv.html. Exact failed driver/log retained; second uses same phone-only composition as joystick builder.

robolectricCallbacksAndResourceTests.reason: This checkout has no Gradle/Robolectric distribution or dependency cache; no large dependency download into the nearly full filesystem. Actual shipping host was compiled into both small fixtures and its extracted Java URL policy executed; neither substitutes for actual WebView lifecycle tests.

compatibilityReview.manifest: Launcher activity already exported=true; original two permissions retained; min26 fixed.
compatibilityReview.receivers: No BroadcastReceiver/registerReceiver/PendingIntent/foreground service in current shipping host or read-only Observer; no API34 receiver-flags change needed.
compatibilityReview.nsd: Existing NsdManager.registerService advertises current TCP port; no Wi-Fi discovery/scanning API added. Target35 does not adopt the newer target37 local-network permission requirement.
compatibilityReview.storage: WebView DOM storage remains enabled at fixed https://game-kit.invalid origin; file/content access disabled, no external-storage API or migration.
compatibilityReview.insets: Android15 enforces edge-to-edge at target35; existing immersive fullscreen remains, but actual TV screenshot/inset/focus/resume validation is required.
compatibilityReview.query: Bounded same-origin entry query; exact indexed resource path independent of query. Fragment, authority/userinfo/port/scheme changes, encoded or dot-segment paths, invalid/control/backslash escapes rejected.
compatibilityReview.target35Meaning: Separate compatibility trial; not proof that Play Protect will accept this APK. No claimed install/driver/gameplay success.
compatibilityReview.sourceReuse: Shared production source changes mean old packages must continue using their existing frozen production/QA refs; new HEAD is not proof of source identity for old APKs.
